The function should sum these scores across all matches and declare the team with the higher total score as the winner. If both teams have the same total score, the result should be a 'Draw'.

This misalignment leads to incorrect score accumulation and potentially incorrect determination of the winner. 2. Update the input reading logic to correctly assign scores to the respective teams.
3. Ensure that the cumulative scores are calculated correctly based on the corrected input handling.
